# libvpx v1.16.0 (VP8 only, generic C)

From https://chromium.googlesource.com/webm/libvpx, tag v1.16.0. Generated by `scripts/vendor_libvpx.py`: the VP8 encoder and decoder and what they use, without assembly or SIMD; the config and run-time dispatch headers written for a generic C build. Built by `crates/wce_video/build.rs`. BSD-3-Clause (`LICENSE`) with Google's patent grant (`PATENTS`).
